findings.affected_requirement: specs/001-codegraph-extraction/plan.md lines 134-135 requires a safe working-copy acquisition failure; the Full quality-review contract requires cancellation, failure containment, edge-case, and regression-test assessment.
findings.evidence: The original working copy remains canonical until the replacement clone succeeds, and every observed swap failure returns failure without profiling the old remote, so this does not reopen Q4.1-001. However, cancellation from RunGitAsync at line 98 propagates before any TryDeleteDirectory call and can leave a partial .rebind-* clone containing source and remote metadata. The nonzero-clone branch also ignores cleanup failure, while stale cleanup failure intentionally leaves .stale-* behind. The added regression test proves only the successful A-to-B rebind; it does not exercise clone cancellation, clone failure with cleanup failure, replacement-move rollback, or stale cleanup failure.
findings.correction_outcome: Use a finally-backed replacement cleanup path that runs after cancellation and every unsuccessful rebind, preserve fail-closed rollback semantics, and add injected process/filesystem tests covering cancellation, clone failure, replacement-move rollback, and cleanup failure. This is bounded nonblocking debt because the current implementation does not profile the old remote after detecting a mismatch and exposes only sanitized diagnostics.

summary: ACCEPT: the exact pinned hashes and diff were verified twice. Q4.1-001 is closed: AcquireAsync compares the reusable checkout's origin URL with the current Repository GitUrl, clones the replacement before moving the old checkout, fails closed on clone/swap/cleanup errors, and the two-remote regression proves the second Profiled Revision and content come from remote B under the same Repository identity. Remote output and Git failures are not exposed; coordinator Git-failure details and missing-provider logs are bounded and sanitized. The three focused corrected regressions passed. No Critical or High correctness, security, architecture, or regression issue was found; one Medium cancellation/temporary-directory cleanup and test-coverage gap remains.
